Voters cast ballots for slates of electors who are representatives to the Electoral College [d20539685s6p0].
States are allocated electors equal to their number of congressional districts plus two senators [d20539685s6p0][d20675670s6p0][d17345901s2p0].
Most states award all of their electoral votes to the statewide popular vote winner (winner-take-all) [d20539685s6p0][d20675670s6p0][d17345901s2p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: What ballot access, voter registration, and absentee voting procedures were in place in Maryland for the 2008 election?
sub_answers.text:
All candidates who appear on the ballot or qualify to receive write-in votes must submit a list of electors pledged to them [d20539685s6p0][d20675670s6p0].
Election law governs ballot access, voter registration, and absentee-voting procedures through regulation of the electoral system and voting processes [d864164s0p0].
States have primary responsibility for conducting elections and prosecute many forms of election offenses related to registration and absentee ballots [d382165s1p0][d864164s0p0].
